name: market_sector_layer
written: 2026-11-20 ~16:45 ET, before any script, ETF fetch or outcome for this purpose; arm_then_fire (same fires) is NOT yet scored
operator: 11/20: multisource_stack came back UNPROVEN by design (trending sample ~1,486 events; MDE 63-252 bp vs a 60 bp bar) -> 'Yes, draft the wider news + market prereg'. Stack principle (operator 11/20): signals from DIFFERENT sources work together; news, the market and the sector are sources outside the name's own price/volume.
scope (what is new vs already covered): WIDE NEWS alone is already registered and runs tonight: arm_then_fire scores news ARMS (W1/W2/W3) on the four price FIRES across the warehouse universe. This prereg adds what no study has scored on that wide set: (a) the market+sector tailwind R1 (multisource_stack's definition, verbatim) as a layer on the same fires, and (b) the two-source stack NEWS AND R1. It reuses arm_then_fire's fires, news classification, filters, hold and spread rules unchanged.
prior_work_disclosed: spy_drop_confirm (11/18): skipping desk signals after SPY fell >= 5 bp in 5 minutes - FAIL, skipped signals no worse (market timing alone looked like noise on desk signals). sector lead-lag (10/15): buying laggards after their sector ETF jumped - FAIL (gross -1/-2 bp; a different question: catch-up, not tailwind). market_temperature (10/3): day-level hot-morning throttle - FAIL. regime_beta_family R5 (11/7): a morning follow-through regime - registered, result separate. catalyst_primary (11/18): news names as desk supply - ALL FAIL on real spreads. NOT tested anywhere: a fire whose OWN sector ETF and SPY were both rising in the 15 minutes before it, against same-trigger fires whose sector was not; nor news AND that tailwind together. Odds on this test's own merit (operator 11/20).
events: the arm_then_fire fires exactly as built there (ai_reports/arm_then_fire/fires.pkl after amended_2): triggers F1 RVOL, F2 BREAK, F3 TURN, F4 MOVER on warehouse SIP 1-minute bars, top-400 by prior-day dollar volume, ETFs/ETPs excluded, price $20-$400 at the fire bar, fire bar 09:45-15:29 ET, one fire per (trigger, name) per 30 minutes. SEARCH 2026-04-28..2026-08-31, halves split 2026-07-15; CONFIRM 2026-09-01..2026-11-19 reported as information.

layers (known by the CLOSE of fire bar t.R1 tailwind (verbatim from multisource_s: SPY 15-minute return to close[t] > 0 AND the name's sector ETF 15-minute return to close[t] > 0; sector ETF = the one of XLK XLF XLE XLV XLI XLY XLP XLU XLB XLRE XLC SMH XBI IBIT KRE with the highest correlation of daily returns to the name over the 60 sessions before the fire day; SPY alone if none has correlation >= 0.3 (share printed)
layers (known by the CLOSE of fire bar t.SECTOR only: the sector ETF's 15-minute return minus SPY's > 0 (the sector beating the market), names with a mapped ETF only
layers (known by the CLOSE of fire bar t.NEWS: armed in any window W1/W2/W3 by arm_then_fire's qualifying-headline rule (latency, recap, reactive, bearish, late-update filters of its amended_1/amended_2); UNARMED as defined there

cells (scored).C1 R1: R1-ON fire vs same-trigger R1-OFF fires within +/-15 minutes on other names
cells (scored).C2 SECTOR: SECTOR-ON fire vs same-trigger SECTOR-OFF fires within +/-15 minutes on other names (SPY is shared at a given minute, so this isolates the sector)
cells (scored).C3 NEWS AND R1: armed AND R1-ON fire vs same-trigger UNARMED AND R1-OFF fires within +/-15 minutes (the two-source stack)
cells (scored).per trigger: each of C1-C3 for F1-F4: 12 cells

trade and outcome: arm_then_fire's: buy the OPEN of t+1, sell the CLOSE of t+30; beta-adjusted gross (return - beta x SPY over the same bars, beta from prior sessions) - the operator's name-minus-SPY scoreboard
statistic: lift = the ON fire's beta-adjusted gross minus the mean of up to 5 OFF peers (capped by hash, as arm_then_fire amended_2); fires with no OFF peer dropped and counted; day-clustered t; per half
power gate (before any outcome is read): ON/OFF counts per cell and half, and a projected MDE = 2.8 x day-clustered SE from the SD of the 30-minute return BEFORE each fire (no outcomes). A cell with MDE > 12 bp in either half is UNPROVEN by design and not scored for EDGE (arm_then_fire's bar).

pass (per cell).EDGE: lift > 0 in both halves, pooled day-clustered t >= 2.87 (two-sided 5% over 12 cells); the same-name later control (entry in exit+2..exit+62 on the same name-day, same hold) and the unconditional random-minute control also > 0; each control printed beside the random-minute mean, a gap > 2 SE blocks
pass (per cell).PROFITABLE (only with EDGE): mean net >= +2 bp in both halves after the real SIP spread (half at entry + half at exit, median quote over 60 s), 15 bp entry gate, >= 300 traded per half; net > 0 at 1.5 x spread

reported (information, never a verdict): R1 split by SPY-only vs sector-only vs both up (which part carries any lift)
market open-gap split (<= -1% / flat / >= +1%) and wick-pressure split, as amended into the sibling preregs
the share of the desk's own 11/17-11/20 fills that were R1-ON, with their name-minus-SPY
data: warehouse SIP 1-minute bars (fires, SPY); SIP 1-minute RTH bars for the 15 sector ETFs over 2026-02-01..2026-11-19 (60-session correlation warm-up) - NOT in the warehouse, fetched once after 16:05 ET or on the weekend (shared data key; ~15 symbols, small); daily closes for the correlations from the same bars; quotes for spreads only for EDGE cells (gross-first).
checks: unit tests: R1 uses only bars closed at or before t; the ETF map uses only sessions before the fire day; peers exclude the name and match the trigger and the +/-15 minute window; SECTOR excludes unmapped names
invariance: layers computed from data truncated at the fire bar equal the full computation
canaries: ETF returns shuffled across days (20 seeds) must not read EDGE in more than 10% per cell; a planted +15 bp on C1 F2 ON fires must read EDGE; a canary failure = no verdict
counts printed: fires per trigger, ON share per cell and half, mapped share, dropped (no peer), ETF fetch failures (> 2% of ETF-days = no verdict)
fail: anything short of pass. No retuning of the 15-minute window, the ETF list, the 0.3 correlation floor, the peer window, the hold or the cells; a change is a new prereg on seen data.
if_pass: result-skeptic review; IEX rescore (the live desk sees IEX ETF bars; the stack logger records ETF snapshots per minute); forward check on the logger's live sessions; then a default-off context gate on the desk's arms
if_fail: record the cell table; the market/sector tailwind does not lift these fires at 30 minutes, alone or stacked with news
pre_run_review: result-skeptic reviews this prereg before any code runs (standing checkpoint)
script: tools/studies/market_sector_layer.py (to be written after the review; reuses arm_then_fire's loaders and peer code)
status: amended_1 after skeptic round 1; script after the ETF fetch (weekend)

amended_1.when: 2026-11-20 ~17:00 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 (FIX FIRST: 8 findings), before any script, ETF fetch or outcome, and before arm_then_fire is scored
amended_1.1 commit: committed now, before arm_then_fire scores (its armed cells would partly reveal C3)
amended_1.2 warm-up: sector ETF bars fetched from 2026-01-15; the map needs >= 50 of the 60 overlapping sessions for name and ETF, else the name is UNMAPPED; daily return = last RTH bar close for both
amended_1.3 stale bars: each series (SPY, ETF) uses its last bar closed at or before t and at or before t-15, each at most 2 minutes old; otherwise R1 is UNKNOWN and the fire is excluded and counted; unit test
amended_1.4 C1 is the sector given SPY: stated: same-minute peers mostly share SPY, so C1 is approximately the sector effect given SPY. C1 and C2 are scored on MAPPED names only, with peers in the SAME SPY state (15-minute SPY return sign) and matched as arm_then_fire amended_1 #3 (volatility tercile, open-gap bucket); unmapped names reported separately with their share
amended_1.5 C3 must beat both singles: C3 is EDGE only if armed+R1-ON beats BOTH armed+R1-OFF peers AND unarmed+R1-ON peers, each at the cell bar (both halves, t >= 2.87); the full 2x2 (armed/unarmed x R1 on/off) is printed; C3 inherits arm_then_fire's news controls: same-name placebo (#3a), arm-shift placebo (#3b), ex-earnings split (#4), 72-h exclusion (#6)
amended_1.6 power: MDE = 3.71 x day-clustered SE (80% power at t 2.87, arm_then_fire amended_1 #8), > 12 bp = UNPROVEN; > 30% of ON fires dropped for no peer = UNPROVEN (#7); peer-weighted control mean; SE over days with both ON and OFF fires only, with those day counts printed per half
amended_1.7 controls: time-shift placebo: R1 read at t +/- 60..120 minutes on the same day (20 shifts), EDGE in <= 10% per cell; information: the mapped ETF's own beta-adjusted return over t+1..t+30 ON vs OFF (sector continuation vs name-specific); top-1% winsorize veto (arm_then_fire amended_1 #9) on every cell
amended_1.8 family: the 5-minute lookback, the R1 decomposition and the gap/wick splits are never promoted; this prereg shares a family with arm_then_fire on the same fires; any PASS is at most PROMISING until the IEX rescore and the forward check
